svg.desc: Five schematic panels: distinct input and validation scopes; sample-derived alternative repeat structures; shared-fragment evidence and optional multi-k copy-depth inference; conditional consensus, partial or unresolved candidates and unverified layout hypotheses; independent gene annotation, eligible tRNA-Pro normalization and positional NCRs. All sequences and the relative-depth example are illustrative, not experimental results.
